keyword.zh: 柴油120和电动80的输送距离怎么读

title.zh: 柴油120和电动80的输送距离如何对照

description.en: Electric 80 prints 900 m / 300 m. Diesel 120 prints 150 m / 500 m. The first number is the horizontal cell on both labels.
description.zh: 电动80印 900 m / 300 m。柴油120印 150 m / 500 m。按标题，两个第一数字都是水平。

h1.zh: 柴油120和电动80的输送距离如何对照

directAnswer.en: Electric 80 and Diesel 120 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai with different distance pairs. Electric 80 prints pumping distance (H / V) as 900 m / 300 m, with 60 m³/h and a 110 kW motor. Diesel 120 prints conveying distance (H / V) as 150 m / 500 m, with 100 m³/h and 290 kW from two 145 kW units. A longer horizontal cell on one page is not the vertical cell on the other.
directAnswer.zh: 电动80和柴油120是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵，距离组不同。电动80的输送距离（水平/垂直）为 900 m / 300 m，产量 60 m³/h，电机 110 kW。柴油120的输送距离（水平/垂直）为 150 m / 500 m，产量 100 m³/h，动力 290 kW（两台 145 kW）。一页更长的水平格，不是另一页的垂直格。

heading.en: Where Diesel 120 and Electric 80 print different values
heading.zh: 柴油120和电动80哪些数值不同

body.en: Theoretical output: Diesel 120 prints 100 m³/h; Electric 80 prints 60 m³/h. Hopper capacity: Diesel 120 prints 0.6 m³; Electric 80 prints 0.7 m³. Hydraulic pump: Diesel 120 prints Kawasaki 112 (two units); Electric 80 prints Kawasaki 140 double pump. Max. aggregate size: Diesel 120 prints 6 cm and below; Electric 80 prints 24 mm (≤ 2 cm). Dimensions: Diesel 120 prints 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm; Electric 80 prints 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm. Main unit weight: Diesel 120 prints 8000 kg; Electric 80 prints 6000 kg. The same printed value on a shared label: Max. outlet pressure is 40 MPa on both pages. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 理论输送量：柴油120印 100 m³/h；电动80印 60 m³/h。料斗容积：柴油120印 0.6 m³；电动80印 0.7 m³。液压泵：柴油120印 Kawasaki 112 (two units)；电动80印 Kawasaki 140 double pump。最大骨料粒径：柴油120印 6 cm and below；电动80印 24 mm (≤ 2 cm)。外形尺寸：柴油120印 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm；电动80印 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm。整机重量：柴油120印 8000 kg；电动80印 6000 kg。同一标题下数值相同的有：最大出口压力两边都是 40 MPa。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: Diesel 120 prints cells that Electric 80 does not: Diesel engine power 290 kW (two units 145 kW); Conveying distance (H / V) 150 m / 500 m. Electric 80 prints cells that Diesel 120 does not: Model line Electric 80 / HBT80-1816-110; Motor power 110 kW; Pumping distance (H / V) 900 m / 300 m. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: 柴油120有、电动80没有的行：柴油机功率 290 kW (two units 145 kW)；输送距离（水平/垂直） 150 m / 500 m。电动80有、柴油120没有的行：型号行 Electric 80 / HBT80-1816-110；电机功率 110 kW；输送距离（水平/垂直） 900 m / 300 m。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: Read the H / V label before comparing 900 m with 500 m. They sit in different positions in the pair. Open /en/products/diesel-120-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 120 and /en/products/electric-80-concrete-pump/ for Electric 80. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 比较 900 m 和 500 m 之前先看水平/垂直标题。它们在数对里的位置不同。看柴油120请打开 /zh/products/diesel-120-concrete-pump/，看电动80请打开 /zh/products/electric-80-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Diesel 120 print the same theoretical output as Electric 80?
question.zh: 柴油120和电动80的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 120 prints 100 m³/h. Electric 80 prints 60 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油120印 100 m³/h。电动80印 60 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Diesel 120 print the same hopper capacity as Electric 80?
question.zh: 柴油120和电动80的料斗容积一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 120 prints 0.6 m³. Electric 80 prints 0.7 m³. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油120印 0.6 m³。电动80印 0.7 m³。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Diesel 120 print the same hydraulic pump as Electric 80?
question.zh: 柴油120和电动80的液压泵一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 120 prints Kawasaki 112 (two units). Electric 80 prints Kawasaki 140 double pump. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油120印 Kawasaki 112 (two units)。电动80印 Kawasaki 140 double pump。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is diesel engine power missing on Electric 80?
question.zh: 为什么电动80没有柴油机功率？

answer.en: The Electric 80 page does not print that label. Diesel 120 prints 290 kW (two units 145 kW). Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: 电动80这一页没有印这个标题。柴油120印的是 290 kW (two units 145 kW)。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。
